BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Your questions.
Considered.

A practical starting point for your underground cabling enquiry.

Is excavation included with underground cabling?

Excavation, duct installation, cable work and surface reinstatement should each be identified in the quotation. Some projects package them together; others split responsibility between civil and electrical contractors.

What drawings are needed to review a cable installation?

Useful documents include the route layout, cable schedule, single-line diagram, duct details and available utility records. The location of supply points, crossings and equipment connections should also be shown.

Can an existing underground cable network be extended?

An extension depends on the existing network condition, capacity and route availability. Review the current drawings and test information alongside the proposed new loads before deciding the extent of the work.
